items.title: Steve Buckingham, interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 25, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Well he was the highest paid musician for a long time in LA.

ctx.x: Well he was the highest paid musician for a long time in LA. His Special Payments checks were astronomical. And rightfully so. He was phenomenal. He is phenomenal. But he was the highest paid player in LA for a long, long time. By far. Every year they’d say, “An unnamed reed player in Los Angeles again had the biggest Special Payment check.” But everybody knew it was Tom Scott.
That’s good info. Well I’ve got to get in a thing about — I know you’re passionate about black music and how it affected bringing the races together.
